scope: Only group-6 evidence, assessments, review and reproducibility helpers. No producer/shared metadata/site edits, pushes, merges or CI controls.

capabilityEvidenceMethod.immutableSource: Exact GitHub revisions fetched through executable source-nar-bindings.nix; registered NAR hashes read from ValidPaths read-only; every inspected regular source file matches the fetched immutable tree.
capabilityEvidenceMethod.ci: Successful head_sha-bound check runs, exact job IDs/native runners, raw CI logs, check-attribute→drv evaluation lines, fresh building lines where present and actual runtime assertions.
capabilityEvidenceMethod.derivationArtifacts: Actual .drv files copied where locally available; parsed using Python ast.literal_eval on the Derive tuple, preserving exact output identities, inputs and environment.
capabilityEvidenceMethod.outputHashes: Read-only ValidPaths rows for exact parsed output paths; hex SHA256 converted to SRI. Registration is identity evidence, not execution proof.
capabilityEvidenceMethod.nativeSdk: Nineteen principal SDK/version bindings have recovered raw derivations and exact dependency paths from the successful native sample check. Auxiliary checks receive no inferred SDK-map claim.
capabilityEvidenceMethod.localVerification: Ten exact CI drv output realizations succeeded, plus fresh PDM simple-runs and Poetry app-runs builds. Additional pnpm fixture-tests exact realization disambiguates current pnpm12.9.0 from independent giget pnpm11.27.0.
capabilityEvidenceMethod.platform: 352 native Linux derivation records including18 expression-built independent-sample records;72 Darwin evaluation-only records have build=null. No Darwin runtime claim.

remainingProofGaps.darwin: All12 workflows schedule native Linux only; absent native Darwin source/SDK/derivation/output/runtime receipts.

remainingProofGaps.outputMetadata: Some CI checks, including the independent Pipenv test check, lack local output NARs; exact drv/output path and successful native builder receipt are retained. The separate locally realized Pipenv sample package has registered output NARs. Do not invent missing hashes.
remainingProofGaps.policyTransport: Direct Python HTTP retrieval of policy pages was blocked by domain allowlist; official primary pages were inspected with web browsing and preserved in policy/browse-receipt.json. Live Dart archive VERSION endpoint inaccessible; current3.13 line corroborated by official language evolution, announcement and docs.

producerCoordination: producer-candidates/coordination.json; current-main reviews are separate from unreleased pip/pnpm candidates. No automatic promotion.
assessmentSemantics: Not-met states document exactly what inspected evidence does not demonstrate; they do not assert tool failure or infer EOL from a newer release. Exact supported current-line points suffice where primary policy identifies them; no all-patch range claims.
